meta.title: Why Microservices Swapped REST for gRPC

hook.text: Why do high-scale microservices ditch REST and JSON for gRPC?
hook.promise: Explain why gRPC outperforms REST in backend systems

design.visualThesis: gRPC eliminates text serialization overhead and TCP connection queues by using compact binary Protobuf over a single multiplexed HTTP/2 pipe.
design.motionGrammar: Crisp transitions, glowing stream paths, data packet movement, and dynamic metric meters.
design.assetLanguage: Original SVG graphics, glowing technical schematics, structured code snippets, and network diagrams.

scenes.purpose: Hook the viewer with the industry shift from REST to gRPC
scenes.narration: Why do high-scale microservices ditch REST and JSON for gRPC? Here is the architecture secret in sixty seconds.

motion.action: Confrontation between REST and gRPC with speed gauges

scenes.purpose: Explain the text bloat and TCP overhead of REST
scenes.narration: With REST, services exchange bloated text strings. Every single request parses redundant field keys in JSON, while opening heavy new TCP handshakes.

motion.action: Highlight repeated key strings in JSON and queue of blocked connections
motion.settle: Latency and CPU waste highlighted in red

scenes.purpose: Demonstrate Protocol Buffers binary serialization and strict schema
scenes.narration: gRPC replaces JSON with Protocol Buffers. Instead of sending raw text, you define a strict schema that compiles into compact binary. Payloads shrink dramatically and serialize up to ten times faster.

motion.action: Transform proto schema into compact binary stream with 10x throughput meter

scenes.purpose: Visualize HTTP/2 multiplexing across a single persistent TCP connection
scenes.narration: Next is the transport: HTTP/2. Instead of waiting in line, gRPC multiplexes hundreds of concurrent requests over one persistent TCP connection with zero head-of-line blocking.

motion.action: Interleave multiple color-coded request streams simultaneously through one glowing pipe

scenes.purpose: Show the four communication modes with focus on streaming
scenes.narration: And unlike REST, you get streaming natively. Client streaming, server streaming, and full bidirectional streams keep data flowing in real time.

motion.action: Two microservice nodes streaming real-time data packets back and forth

scenes.purpose: Provide the practical architecture rule of thumb and call to action
scenes.narration: The rule of thumb: use gRPC internally between backend microservices, and keep REST for public web clients. What does your team build with?
onScreenText: The Rule: gRPC Inside, REST Outside
What does your team build with?

motion.action: Draw cluster boundary separating public edge REST from internal gRPC mesh
motion.settle: Clear system architecture blueprint and audience prompt

outro.takeaway: Use gRPC for internal backend microservices; keep REST for public edge clients.
outro.cta: What does your team build with?
